intro: Pilfered Windstones is a local quest on Zephras where players recover vital stolen resources from the Highlands Bandits. Stored in reserve for emergencies, these windstones are crucial for daily survival, but local peacekeepers are too stretched by cultist threats to clear out the thieves themselves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.
We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.
If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: These sneakthieves have likely been breaking into our supplies for months. I tried to convince Aonda to put a raid together to clear out that bandit cave for good, but she didn't want to pull the few peacekeepers we have away from the village.
With the cultists at Falaath Village to the south growing in numbers, I suppose I can't fault her for that.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks adventurer. This should help us get by for now. If we can't get the supply routes squared away soon though, a few stolen windstones will be the least of our worries.
